en_title: Sony Patent Would Let an AI Model Train NPCs Based On Your Player Data
cn_title: 索尼新专利拟用玩家数据训练NPC
subtitle: 敌人会学你的打法？
opus_summary: 索尼申请新专利，拟用玩家游玩时产生的数据训练AI，调整NPC的外观和行为，让角色更逼真，并减少脚本编写与资源投入。该技术未必会用于实际产品，云端处理数据也可能带来泄露风险。

paragraphs.en: If one thing's been abundantly clear over the last year, it's that Sony and Microsoft are both champing at the bit to work AI features into the next generation of consoles. And now, Sony has filed another patent that would use AI to train NPCs based on data generated by you, the player.
paragraphs.cn: 过去一年，有一点已经十分明显：索尼和微软都迫不及待地想把AI功能引入下一代主机。如今，索尼又申请了一项专利，计划利用玩家产生的数据训练NPC。

paragraphs.en: This new patent, called "AI-adapted non-player character for video game system," describes a process of taking data generated from playing a game and then using it to modify NPCs in order to make them more lifelike.
paragraphs.cn: 这项名为「用于电子游戏系统的AI自适应非玩家角色」的专利，描述了如何利用玩家游玩时产生的数据调整NPC，让它们更逼真。

paragraphs.en: But unlike Nvidia's ACE program , which uses a large language model to essentially script NPC dialogue, Sony's proposed system could change everything about an NPC, from its design to its behavior in, say, a boss fight. Sony asserts that this is necessary to create more lifelike games, without bloating development time and budgets even more than they already are.
paragraphs.cn: 英伟达的ACE项目利用大语言模型生成NPC对话，而索尼提出的系统可能改变NPC的方方面面，从外观设计到其在Boss战中的行为。索尼认为，要在不进一步增加开发时间和预算的情况下打造更逼真的游戏，这套系统是必要的。

paragraphs.en: The patent says that "developing such believable NPCs is challenging due to limitations of modern game development and often relies extensive scripting and programming. Additionally, NPC development often relies on sophisticated systems and extensive resources to track, animate, and evolve NPC behaviors. In a typical development environment, NPC management often utilizes costly and efficient rendering engines, simulation engines, and scalable systems capable of supporting increasingly detailed virtual environments and lifelike NPC interactions."
paragraphs.cn: 专利文件写道：「受现代游戏开发条件所限，要打造这样可信的NPC并不容易，往往需要编写大量脚本和程序。此外，开发NPC通常还需要复杂的系统和大量资源，才能追踪、制作并逐步丰富NPC的行为。在常见的开发环境中，管理NPC往往要用到昂贵而高效的渲染引擎、模拟引擎，以及能够支持愈发精细的虚拟环境和逼真NPC互动的可扩展系统。」

paragraphs.en: The solution, according to this patent, is to use AI to do most of this work. It continues, "The techniques described herein overcome the foregoing challenges and others by providing an artificial intelligence (AI)-adapted NPC. By using the techniques described herein, video game systems can be improved." Using AI to shortcut development time is nothing new, but that's not the whole reason that Sony patented this technology. It seems to think the player data will make NPCs even better than before."
paragraphs.cn: 按照这项专利的说法，解决办法是让AI承担其中的大部分工作。文件接着写道：「本文所述技术通过提供AI自适应NPC，克服了上述及其他难题。运用这些技术可以改进电子游戏系统。」用AI缩短开发时间并不新鲜，但这似乎不是索尼为该技术申请专利的全部原因。索尼似乎还认为，玩家数据能让NPC比以往表现得更好。

paragraphs.en: Sony continues: "Additionally, by using the techniques described herein, lifelike NPCs that behave based on behaviors exhibited by video game players and/or responsive to behaviors exhibited by video game players can be seamlessly integrated into video game systems and video game content thereby improving video game systems without the extensive scripting and hardware resources."
paragraphs.cn: 索尼还写道：「此外，运用本文所述技术，可以将逼真的NPC无缝融入电子游戏系统和游戏内容。这些NPC能够依据玩家的行为行动，和／或对玩家的行为作出反应，从而无需大量脚本和硬件资源，也能改进电子游戏系统。」

paragraphs.en: Just like any of the other patents that Sony has been spitting out at a rapid clip, there's no guarantee this system would actually make its way to a PlayStation 5 (or more likely PlayStation 6) near you. However, the game industry has been experimenting with ways to use AI to train NPCs for years now. Just last year, Inzoi used LLMs, along with player input to shape how NPCs would interact with the player and each other.
paragraphs.cn: 和索尼近期接连申请的其他专利一样，没人能保证这套系统最终会出现在玩家的PS5上，或是更有可能的PlayStation 6上。不过，游戏行业多年来一直在探索如何利用AI训练NPC。就在去年，《inZOI》还结合大语言模型与玩家输入，决定NPC如何与玩家及其他NPC互动。

paragraphs.en: It's only a matter of time, then, before AI is used to train different parts of NPC behavior with your data. I could see a world where the bosses in a game like Elden Ring evolve to counter your playstyle, or an enemy in a horror game stalking you more effectively because it 'knows' how you react to different stimuli.
paragraphs.cn: 照此看来，利用玩家数据、通过AI训练NPC的各种行为，或许只是时间问题。我能想象，《艾尔登法环》这样的游戏里，Boss会逐渐学会克制你的打法；恐怖游戏中的敌人则因为「知道」你面对不同刺激时会如何反应，而更有效地追踪你。

paragraphs.en: However, there would be questions about security. As cool as having smarter NPCs would be, if these models are processed in the cloud, there would be a risk of your data leaking out onto the internet. And while it doesn't seem like advertisers would want know how you react to a giant monster swinging an axe at you, it probably will end up being used for 'enhanced marketing,' too.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，安全问题也随之而来。NPC变得更聪明固然很酷，但如果这些模型在云端处理，玩家数据就有泄露到互联网上的风险。广告商似乎不会想知道，当一个挥着斧头的巨型怪物朝你袭来时，你会有什么反应；但这些数据很可能最终也会被用于「加强营销」。

paragraphs.en: This is hardly the first of Sony's strange new patents. Just a couple of weeks ago, the company patented a system where AI would detect problems with your console and deliver vibe-coded patches . It also patented a controller with an NFC card reader that would bring tap-to-pay to your PlayStation. The next generation of consoles is shaping up to be a strange one, to say the least.
paragraphs.cn: 这远不是索尼近期申请的第一项奇特专利。就在几周前，索尼为一套能让AI检测主机故障、并提供通过氛围编程生成的补丁的系统申请了专利。索尼还为一款带有NFC读卡器的手柄申请了专利，让玩家能在PlayStation上刷卡支付。下一代主机，至少可以说，似乎会很不寻常。
